<title level="1" right="Class Feature 15">[Greater Spirit Striking](/Classes.aspx?ID=65)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 28

**Class** Exemplar
</column>

---

Your additional damage from spirit striking increases to 4 with weapons and unarmed attacks in which you're an expert, 6 if you're a master, and 8 if you're legendary.
name: Greater Spirit Striking
